verdict: Ads are running and converting, but lead tracking has a confirmed gap.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, Google Ads recorded 16 conversions on $1,687.76 in spend — but those conversions are not appearing in your CRM, meaning real inquiries are likely being missed or going untracked rather than reflecting a drop in demand. The most probable cause is a routing issue in the lead intake system, which we are actively diagnosing and correcting this week. Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply over the past 7 days, including three consecutive days of zero engagement, which we are monitoring closely heading into the final stretch of summer. Next period, expect lead tracking to be restored and the intake path confirmed, which will give you a clean, reliable count of every inquiry your ads are producing.
